newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST - Norway Nov CPI seen unchanged from Oct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Norway Nov CPI seen unchanged from Oct.

text.p: Eight economists polled by Reuters expected on average Norway's consumer price index to be unchanged in November from October and to rise 1.8 percent year-on-year.
The range for the monthly CPI forecast was between 0.0 and +0.1 percent.
The average estimate for 1996 inflation was 1.3 percent, while 1997 inflation was forecast at 2.5 percent in the range 2.4 to 2.8 percent.
November inflation figures are due on December 10 at 0845 GMT.
Contributors to the poll were Christiania Bank, Chase Manhattan Bank, Den Danske Bank, Fiba Nordic Securities, Elcon Securities, Orkla Finans, Bergen Fonds and Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken.
